description: This file defines an API client for a Learning Management System (LMS) frontend, including mock data, API fetch wrapper, and high-level API methods with support for fallback to mock data when API or environment is unavailable. It manages courses, assignments, enrollments, and submission functionalities, with optional integration with Supabase.

methods.name: apiFetch
methods.description: Wrapper around fetch that uses configured API base, with error handling and fallback to mock data.

methods.name: listCourses
methods.description: Lists courses with optional search, filter, and pagination, using REST API or mock data.

methods.name: getCourse
methods.description: Retrieves course details by ID, using REST API or mock data.

methods.name: getAssignments
methods.description: Fetches assignments for a specific course, via REST API or mock data.

methods.name: enroll
methods.description: Enrolls the user in a course, via Supabase or mock data.

methods.name: unenroll
methods.description: Unenrolls the user from a course, via Supabase or mock data.

methods.name: myCourses
methods.description: Retrieves current user's enrolled courses, via Supabase or mock data.

methods.name: submitAssignment
methods.description: Submits an assignment, supporting text or file metadata, via Supabase or mock data.
